page: Microsoft Azure E16ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the Edsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores with hyper-threading. Operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz, this x86_64 architecture server includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for accelerated vector and matrix operations.

The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It also includes 945 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong single-threaded performance, notably in Geekbench single-core tests and single-threaded gzip compression. Multi-core performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks generally fall within the average range, with uncached large-block read bandwidth reaching 123.39 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 69.2 GB/sec.

This hardware profile offers a balanced cost-efficiency model for memory-intensive workloads that do not require dedicated GPU acceleration. The combination of high-capacity RAM, fast local NVMe storage, and dedicated Intel Xeon processing power makes the E16ds_v6 well-suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics, and medium-scale enterprise applications.
